records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Introduction to Women's, Gender, and Sexuality Studies
records.description: Analysis of gender and power in contemporary society from perspectives of different racial, ethnic and socioeconomic groups.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Sex, Race, and Reproduction in Global Health Politics
records.description: Examination of how cultures, institutions, states, and economies influence reproductive health inequalities around gender, sexuality, race, class, and national identity.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Sex Matters: Introduction to Queer Culture and Literature
records.description: Introduction to Lesbian/queer cultural production focusing on popular culture, fiction, and film; work from various queer communities in its cultural/historical context. (Crosslisted course offered as WGSS 211, ENGLISH 211.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Introduction to American Cultural Studies
records.description: Introduction to the interdisciplinary study of American cultures and the field of American studies. (Crosslisted course offered as AMER ST 216, CES 216, ENGLISH 216, HISTORY 216, WGSS 216.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Gender, Culture and Science
records.description: Analysis of intersections of gender, sexuality, race, and culture with science and technology.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Fat Studies
records.description: Examination of weight-based oppression as a social justice issue with other systems of oppression based on gender, race, class, age, sexual orientation, and ability. (Crosslisted course offered as AMDT 222, WGSS 222.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Human Sexuality
records.description: Sexuality in personal development; personal, cultural, biological influences on sexual identification and behavior; fertility, reproduction, sexual functioning, sexuality and personality. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105. (Crosslisted course offered as PSYCH 230, WGSS 230.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: The Sociology of Sex, Relationships, and Marriage
records.description: Social and personal factors in mate selection; the sociology of sexuality; development of gender roles; and intimate relationships and marriage. (Crosslisted course offered as SOC 251, WGSS 251.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Rhetoric and Gender
records.description: Historical survey of women writers whose contributions distinguish them as rhetoricians of their time. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGLISH 260, WGSS 260.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: History of Women in American Society
records.description: Exploration of the many roles women have played in American society from the Colonial period through the twentieth century. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 298, WGSS 298.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Intersections of Race, Class, Gender, Sexuality, and Dis/ability
records.description: Study of intersections among race, class, gender, sexuality, and dis/ability through case studies; experiences in interdisciplinary methods. (Crosslisted course offered as WGSS 300, ENGLISH 310, SOC 300.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Introduction to Critical Race Feminism
records.description: Studies structural inequalities in the US through historically grounded analysis of social systems, race, gender, and the law.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Contemporary Masculinities
records.description: Analysis of the development of masculinity in its biological and cultural forms. (Crosslisted course offered as WGSS 302, SOC 302.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Gender and Politics
records.description: Role of gender in political behavior; voting and political participation; women as subjects and objects of political systems. (Crosslisted course offered as POL S 305, WGSS 305.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Introduction to Literary Criticism
records.description: Introduction to the systematic study of critical and theoretical approaches to literature; emphasis on problems of interpretation. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGLISH 308, WGSS 306.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Biology of Sex and Gender
records.description: Biological basis of sex and its relationship to body function, women and health care, and the impact of social and cultural perspectives on the experience of being female. (Crosslisted course offered as BIOLOGY 307, WGSS 307.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Women Artists I
records.description: Women artists of the Middle Ages through the 18th century. (Crosslisted course offered as ART 308, WGSS 308.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Women Writers
records.description: Women's artistic and intellectual contributions to prose, fiction, drama, and poetry. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGLISH 309, WGSS 309.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Women Artists II
records.description: Women artists of the 19th to 20th century. (Crosslisted course offered as ART 310, WGSS 310.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Gender in Cross Cultural Perspective
records.description: Cross-cultural examination of gendered status and roles, sexuality and marriage, folk concepts of sexual anatomy in Western and non-Western societies; concepts of nature and culture are explored through a variety of perspectives. Recommended preparation: Sophomore standing. (Crosslisted course offered as ANTH 316, WGSS 316.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Queer Literature
records.description: Queer literature with focus on the history of literature about minoritized genders and sexualities and exploration of current authors. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGLISH 317, WGSS 317.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Topics in Women's, Gender, and Sexuality Studies
records.description: Focused study of subjects/issues relating to women, gender, and sexuality.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Psychology of Gender
records.description: Contemporary overview of the psychological theory and research on sex and gender.  Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105. (Crosslisted course offered as PSYCH 324, WGSS 324.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Global Feminisms
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANTH 101, WGSS 101, or WGSS 120.
records.description: An interdisciplinary approach to examining women's roles and experiences throughout the world and different approaches to feminism/feminisms. (Crosslisted course offered as WGSS 332, ANTH 317.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Women in Latin American History
records.description: Survey of women's changing roles throughout Latin America from pre colonial to present. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 335, WGSS 335.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: History of Sexualities
records.description: Historical analysis of the social construction of sexualities in intersection with race and class within national and transnational contexts.  (Crosslisted course offered as WGSS  336, HISTORY 336.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Gender, Race, and Popular Culture
records.description: Feminist study of intersections of gender, race, class, sexuality, and ability through popular film, television, digital media, art, literature, and performance.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Gender and Decolonial Representation in Film
records.description: Focus on the intersections of race, gender, class, sexuality, and nation in third world women's films.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Witches, Nuns, Merchants, and Queens in Europe 1200-1800
records.description: Women's experiences in Europe from the Renaissance to the Enlightenment and the ideas and roles that affected their lives. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 350, WGSS 350.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: The Family
records.description: Family system and its interaction patterns; family formation and dissolution; marital and partner relations, divorce, sexuality, parenting, work-family balance. Recommended preparation: SOC 101. (Crosslisted course offered as SOC 351, WGSS 351.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Women in Music
records.description: Intersections of gender, class, race, and culture with popular and country music.  (Crosslisted course offered as MUS 363, WGSS 363.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: LGBTQ+ Perspectives in Music
records.description: Exploration of music through the lens of LGBTQ+ representation as a way of examining the personal and social struggles the community has endured for decades. (Crosslisted course offered as MUS 366, WGSS 366.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Queer Identities in Contemporary Cultures
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CES 101, HISTORY 105, HISTORY 305, WGSS 101, or WGSS 120.
records.description: Analysis of roots/legacies of creative resistance writing by Queer communities of color; students learn to produce creative resistance work. (Crosslisted course offered as WGSS 369, HISTORY 369.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Empire, Gender, and Postcoloniality in Global Literature
records.description: Literary/cultural texts and theory focusing on postcolonial conditions (and their gendered operations) in the shadow of empire and imperialism. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGLISH 373, WGSS 373.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: American Literature: 1940-Present
records.description: Advanced study of major authors and movements from the period including O'Connor, Bellow, Salinger, Baldwin, Pynchon, Morrison, Tan, and Alexie. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGLISH 482, WGSS 382.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Sociology of Gender
records.description: Construction and maintenance of gender and gender inequality in American society. Recommended preparation: SOC 101. (Crosslisted course offered as SOC 384, WGSS 384.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, and Queer Studies
records.description: Interdisciplinary exploration of issues related to gender and sexuality, explored transhistorically and cross-culturally, including race, class and age differences. (Crosslisted course offered as WGSS 385, SOC 385.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Gender and Work
records.description: Gender and inequality at work including occupational segregation, wage inequality and balancing work and family. (Crosslisted course offered as SOC 390, WGSS 390.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Women, Gender, and the History of the Un-West
records.description: The multicultural history of women in the west through women's literature, archives, and oral history. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 398, WGSS 398.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: LGBTQ+ History: Culture, Politics, and Social Change in the U.S.
records.description: History and theory of queer sexualities and gender identities in the United States including community development, politics and cultures. (Crosslisted course offered as HISTORY 399, WGSS 399.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Violence Toward Women
records.description: Violence toward women and its relationship to broader social issues such as sexism and social control. (Crosslisted course offered as CRM J 403, WGSS 403.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Women and Work in Global Contexts
records.description: An interdisciplinary approach to women's labor in global contexts that analyzes differences among women as well as possible shared interests.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Gender, Race, and Environmental Literature
records.description: Diversity of writings by queer writers, women writers, and writers of color exploring 20th and 21st century environmental issues of the American West and Pacific Rim through the lens of ecofeminism and environmental justice. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGLISH 409, WGSS 409.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Internship
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: WGSS 101 or 120; WGSS 300 with a B or better, or 481 with a B or better; by interview only.
records.description: Supervised experience in approved campus or community agencies or projects focusing on women's issues.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Asian and Pacific American Women
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CES or WGSS course; junior standing.
records.description: Intersection of ethnicity, race, class, gender and sexuality in the lives of Asian and Pacific American women. (Crosslisted course offered as CES 411, WGSS 411.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Philosophy and Feminism
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: PHIL 101, WGSS 101, or WGSS 120.
records.description: Feminist philosophy as critique of Western philosophical tradition and as alternate framework for thought. (Crosslisted course offered as PHIL 425, POL S 425, WGSS 425.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Gender, Race, and Nature in American Culture
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: WGSS 101, 120, or 300; junior standing.
records.description: Exploration of American culture through examination of cultural representations of nature in mainstream and environmental politics.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Women and Ethics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: PHIL 101, WGSS 101, or WGSS 120.
records.description: Study of gender and feminism and their effect on contemporary ethical theories and issues. (Crosslisted course offered as WGSS 462, PHIL 462.)

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Gender and the Media
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to any major; sophomore standing.
records.description: How news and entertainment media shape and reinforce societal expectations of gender; consideration of race, age, class, and sexual orientation. (Crosslisted course offered as COM 464, WGSS 464.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Feminist Theory
records.description: Introduction to the field of feminist theory, including classic interdisciplinary methods, and applications of this scholarship to contemporary women's issues.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Theoretical Issues in Queer Studies
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: WGSS 484 or any 300-400-level WGSS course.
records.description: Theoretical construction and interpretation of sexualities, gender, and identity.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Re-Directions in Women's, Gender, and Sexuality Studies: Theory and Practice
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  By department permission; WGSS 385; WGSS 481; admitted to the major in Women's, Gender, and Sexuality Studies or to the minor in Women's Studies or Queer Studies; senior standing.
records.description: Seminar-style culminating experience in synthesizing prior learning and new scholarship for application of theory and practice; written and oral communication of original final project research.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: WGSS
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
